column1: # ui-bundle-manifest.tsv — crates that ship a COMMITTED, pre-built UI bundle.
# #3606: trusty-search 0.37.0 published a ui-dist/ built from pre-#3509 source,
# so the shipped dashboard had no dark mode. Three occurrences, no gate.
# Read by scripts/check-ui-bundle-freshness.sh, which is CHECK 7 of
# scripts/preflight-publish.sh. The manifest is checked BOTH ways against what
# the tree actually tracks: a crate that ships a bundle without a row here
# FAILS (MANIFEST-GAP), and a row whose bundle directory has no tracked files
# FAILS (MANIFEST-STALE). Neither direction can be satisfied by doing nothing,
# which is what keeps a green run distinguishable from a run that inspected
# nothing.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   1. crate_dir   directory under crates/ (not the crates.io package name)
#   2. source_dir  UI source root, repo-relative — the Svelte/Vite project
#   3. bundle_dir  committed build output, repo-relative — what cargo packages
# Each bundle_dir carries ui-source-hash.txt, written by
# scripts/stamp-ui-bundle.sh as part of the build. That file is the freshness
# claim; the gate recomputes the digest and compares.
# trusty-search is the odd one out: its bundle lives at crate root as
# ui-dist/ (built into ui/dist/, then mirrored by `make -C crates/trusty-search
# sync-ui`), while the other three commit ui/dist/ directly. That extra mirror
# step is the one that keeps getting skipped.
# crates/trusty-agents has a ui/ but its dist is gitignored (Tauri packages it
# at build time, nothing is embedded from git), so it ships no committed bundle
# and correctly has no row. Adding one would fail NO-BUNDLE.
# #6155: trusty-console ships a SECOND bundle. Under ADR-0032 the console is the
# only HTTP surface, so it serves the trusty-search SPA at /tools/search/ from
# its own copy of that bundle — a published console tarball cannot reach into a
# sibling crate. The row's source_dir is the real Svelte project in
# crates/trusty-search/ui, so a change there marks the console's copy stale.
# That row is keyed `trusty-console-search`, NOT `trusty-console`. The two keys
# have to differ because stamp-ui-bundle.sh stamps every row matching the name
# it is given, and trusty-console's build.rs stamps `trusty-console` after
# building its OWN UI. Share the key and that build re-stamps the search bundle
# it never rebuilt, recording a freshness claim nobody made — the #3606
# laundering the stamp exists to prevent.
# The gate goes the other way on purpose. check-ui-bundle-freshness.sh also
# matches a `<crate>-<suffix>` row when asked about `<crate>`, so
# preflight-publish.sh CHECK 7 for trusty-console inspects both bundles the
# tarball carries. The stamper under-claims, the gate over-checks.
# crate_dir
trusty-search
trusty-memory
trusty-analyze
trusty-console
trusty-console-search
